subject: Security & Compliance architecture review — scheduling (SOC 2, encryption, audit logs, SSO)
messages:
From: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@paywise.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: security@paywise.com
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: Security & Compliance architecture review — Paywise

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the demo last week — we'd like to schedule a deeper technical review with your engineering and security teams focused on SOC 2 evidence, encryption (at-rest and in-transit), audit logging, and SSO integration. Our security team (cc'd) will want to walk through control mappings and any artifacts you can provide.

Preferred windows next week (ET):
- Tue 4/21 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Wed 4/22 14:00–15:00

Attendees from our side are likely me, Melissa Chen (platform security), and our compliance lead (security@paywise.com). Could you confirm who from Redwood should join and whether you can share a short SOC 2 summary and architecture diagram ahead of time? We have an initial questionnaire attached (Paywise-Security-Questionnaire-v2.xlsx) — if you can annotate/control-map, that would be great.

Thanks,
Tom Briggs
Director of IT Risk | Paywise
T: (555) 321-9876

Attachment: Paywise-Security-Questionnaire-v2.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@paywise.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Security & Compliance architecture review — Paywise

Tom — great to hear and happy to set this up. Proposed attendees from Redwood: Grace O'Connor (Security), Dev Patel (Infra/Runtime), and myself (Sales/owner). Avery is cc'd to help with scheduling and calendar logistics.

I can do either of the times on Tue or the Wed slot. Two proposed options (ET):
- Tue 4/21 14:00–14:45 ET (30–45 min technical deep-dive + Q&A)
- Wed 4/22 14:00–14:45 ET

I'll attach a short SOC 2 summary and the current architecture diagram so your team has context. If you want a longer working session we can extend, but for the first pass we typically do 30–45 min to cover evidence locations and integration points.

Agenda (draft):
- Quick intros (5m)
- Architecture walk: data flow, encryption, key management (10m)
- Audit logs & retention + access controls (10m)
- SSO / SCIM / provisioning & control mapping questions (10m)

I attached: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-arch-diagram.png, Redwood-SOC2-control-mapping.xlsx.

Thanks — Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
sean_gallagher@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf), redwood-arch-diagram.png (png), Redwood-SOC2-control-mapping.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@paywise.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Melissa Chen <mchen@paywise.com>, security@paywise.com
Date: Thu, 16 Apr 2026 15:20:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Request: Security & Compliance architecture review — Paywise

Thanks Sean — both options look good. One small ask: can we shift the Tue 4/21 14:00 start by 30 minutes to 14:30–15:15 ET? We have an internal stand that overran that day. If not possible, Wed 4/22 14:00–14:45 ET also works.

Also, can you confirm what artifacts you can provide after the meeting? In particular:
- SOC 2 Type II report or summary (redacted OK)
- Control mappings tied to our questionnaire
- Encryption KMS provider and key rotation policy
- Audit log retention and where logs are stored/forwarded (SIEM options)

I attached a quick note to the questionnaire with a couple of specific questions.

Best,
Tom

To: Tom Briggs <tbriggs@paywise.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 08:02:00 -0400
Subject: Confirmed: Security & Compliance architecture review — Tue 4/21 14:30 ET (rescheduled)

Tom / Melissa / Paywise security team — confirmed. We've moved the meeting to Tue 4/21 14:30–15:15 ET to accommodate your request. Calendar invite attached (calendar-invite-Paywise-arch-review.ics) and shared folder with artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1abcDEFGhIJklmnoPqRS.

Final attendee list (Redwood):
- Grace O'Connor — Head of Security (SOC 2 controls, evidence locations)
- Dev Patel — Infra & Runtime (encryption, KMS, audit logs)
- Sean Gallagher — Sales / customer owner (coordination + next steps)

Requested pre-reads and post-meeting artifacts we will provide:
- Redacted SOC 2 Type II summary (if available) and SOC2 control mapping spreadsheet
- Architecture diagram and sequence flow showing where customer data is encrypted and persisted
- KMS provider details and key rotation policy summary
- Audit-log collection/retention summary (where logs live, retention windows, available exports)
- SSO/SCIM integration notes, supported providers, and provisioning options

Meeting agenda (final):
1) Intros & scope (5m)
2) Architecture walk & data classification boundaries (10m)
3) Encryption & KMS details (10m)
4) Audit logs, retention, access controls (10m)
5) SSO / provisioning / SCIM & next steps (10m)

If Paywise wants any additional artifacts (e.g., penetration test summary, incident response runbook) call that out and we'll surface what we can.

See you Tue 4/21 14:30 ET.

Thanks,
Sean

Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 09:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Confirmed: Security & Compliance architecture review — Tue 4/21 14:30 ET (rescheduled)

Adding two quick notes before the call: 1) we'll bring a short control-mapping workbook to annotate live against Paywise's questionnaire, and 2) Dev will demo where audit logs are stored and how we can stream them to a customer's SIEM. If Paywise can share any prioritized controls ahead of time I'll highlight them in the mapping.

Grace O'Connor
Head of Security | Redwood Inference
